episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Emma and the children have finally escaped the House and now head to the place indicated on the pen Norman gave them. But on their way, a large, wild demon attacks the group…

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Emma and the children have finally escaped the House and now head to the place indicated on the pen Norman gave them. But on their way, a large, wild demon attacks the group…

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The children’s saviors turn out to be demons named Mujika and Sonju. The pair claims that their religion forbids them from eating humans. Emma and Ray visit Sonju while the others are sleeping in order to find out what happened to humans thirty years ago.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: The children’s saviors turn out to be demons named Mujika and Sonju. The pair claims that their religion forbids them from eating humans. Emma and Ray visit Sonju while the others are sleeping in order to find out what happened to humans thirty years ago.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Emma and the group learn the necessary skills to survive in this world from Mujika and Sonju. Back on their own, the children traverse a wasteland in search of a place called “B06-32.”

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: Emma and the group learn the necessary skills to survive in this world from Mujika and Sonju. Back on their own, the children traverse a wasteland in search of a place called “B06-32.”

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Without warning, the shelter’s phone begins to ring, echoing through the halls. Emma hesitantly answers and finds that it is William Minerva. Meanwhile, in an underground room at the farm headquarters, a deal is made…

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: Without warning, the shelter’s phone begins to ring, echoing through the halls. Emma hesitantly answers and finds that it is William Minerva. Meanwhile, in an underground room at the farm headquarters, a deal is made…

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Emma and the other escapees manage to survive the attack on the shelter. Now they have settled in an abandoned temple a short ways from a demon town. Unlike the shelter and Grace Field House, here there is a limited supply of food, and they are barely surviving.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: Emma and the other escapees manage to survive the attack on the shelter. Now they have settled in an abandoned temple a short ways from a demon town. Unlike the shelter and Grace Field House, here there is a limited supply of food, and they are barely surviving.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Norman, thought to have been shipped, stands before Emma and Ray. It is a reunion they never dreamed of, and they embrace tearfully. Norman reveals his plan to create the future Emma wants, where the children can live happily.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: Norman, thought to have been shipped, stands before Emma and Ray. It is a reunion they never dreamed of, and they embrace tearfully. Norman reveals his plan to create the future Emma wants, where the children can live happily.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Though Emma pleads with him, explaining she has no wish to eradicate the demons, Norman is set in his decision and deaf to her arguments. To resolve their dispute, Emma proposes a deal.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: Though Emma pleads with him, explaining she has no wish to eradicate the demons, Norman is set in his decision and deaf to her arguments. To resolve their dispute, Emma proposes a deal.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Norman, seized by a terrible fit of coughing, spits up blood. He lied about not being experimented on when he was at Lambda. With the little time he has left, Norman manages to reunite with Emma and hopes to create a world where she and the children can live in peace.

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: Norman, seized by a terrible fit of coughing, spits up blood. He lied about not being experimented on when he was at Lambda. With the little time he has left, Norman manages to reunite with Emma and hopes to create a world where she and the children can live in peace.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Norman has begun executing his plan without waiting for Emma. When Emma, Ray, and Sonju appear, Norman is hesitating to kill Vylk and his grandchild, but he tells them that they are too late and that the plan is already in motion.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis: Norman has begun executing his plan without waiting for Emma. When Emma, Ray, and Sonju appear, Norman is hesitating to kill Vylk and his grandchild, but he tells them that they are too late and that the plan is already in motion.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Vincent reveals his plan to enter the farm. After hearing this plan, Peter reconfigures the security on the farm to prepare for the intruders. Meanwhile, the shipment of children from the house has been set in motion, and Phil has already arrived at the gate.

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis: Vincent reveals his plan to enter the farm. After hearing this plan, Peter reconfigures the security on the farm to prepare for the intruders. Meanwhile, the shipment of children from the house has been set in motion, and Phil has already arrived at the gate.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: As Emma extends her hand to Peter and says, "Let's be free," he shows a calm expression, but realizes his true fate. The children finally arrive at the gate leading to the human world, where they hope to pass through.

related.title: Yakusoku no Neverland
related.plot: È notte all’orfanotrofio di Grace Field e due ombre corrono verso i cancelli. Emma e Norman, amici per la pelle, vogliono consegnare un animale di pezza a una bimba appena adottata. Per dirle addio e lasciarle un ricordo indelebile: quello dei bambini con cui ha condiviso 12 anni di studio e giochi all’aria aperta, sotto lo sguardo amorevole della tutrice. Orfani che a loro volta se ne sarebbero andati. È notte, Emma e Norman non lo sanno, ma il buio del mondo al di fuori dei cancelli di Grace Field è pronto a inghiottirli.
